## Step 2: Customize your homepage

Good job! You turned on GitHub Pages! :tada:

You can see the link to your website at the top of the [Pages](https://github.com/{{full_repo_name}}/settings/pages) section of your repository settings.

### 📖 Theory: Customizing your homepage

You can customize your homepage by adding content to `index.md` file.

### ⌨️ Activity: Create your homepage

1. Browse to the `index.md` file in the `main` branch.
1. In the upper right corner, open the file editor.
1. Type the content you want on your homepage.
1. Commit your changes to the `main` branch.
